name: Petroleum Industry Act 2021 & Nigerian Fiscal Terms
engineCourse: An ENGINE COURSE: no Suite app. The practicals run in the course's own calculator panels (pia-royalty-calculator, pia-hct-calculator, pia-ledger-calculator) over the vendored engine engines/economics/cashflow.ts; the learning page says so plainly. Lead decisions (cat-brief): the same published fee and the same Associate/Professional/Expert certificate ladder as app courses; no Suite bridge mapping; prerequisite null.
goldensNote: EMPTY BY DECISION, as SC2 and D5. The vendored golden test-data/economics/goldens/pia2021_cases.json carries oracle output beside its inputs. The digest reads its INPUTS only and prints the engine's own figures; naming the golden here would let numsweep resolve a lesson literal against an oracle figure the digest never prints.
enginesVendoredAt: NextGen packages/engines already carries engines/economics/cashflow.ts at ENGINE_VERSION 3.12.0, sha-identical with petrolord-engines 3778451 (engines PR #262), with its golden pia2021_cases.json, oracle_pia2021.py, FINDINGS-pia2021.md and AUDIT-PIA-2021.md, vendored by the cashflow and fiscal re-cut (NextGen #266, VENDOR.json group ec7-pia-recut). THIS COURSE VENDORS NOTHING: every packages/engines path is byte-identical to origin/main (prove_prior_courses.sh part 1).

history.position: THIS COURSE TEACHES NO REPAIR HISTORY. The engine was brought into line with the gazetted texts (engines PR #262) before any lesson was written; that is provenance. The digest describes the engine as it is. Two engine refusals end with a sentence naming the platform reproduction switch pia_legacy_pre_audit; the digest prints them verbatim and the briefs tell writers to quote their first sentences only.

regulatoryRule: Every Act, regulation and statement taught is named with its edition or gazette date and the date read (2026-09-26), printed in digest section 2 and asserted against the vendored FINDINGS-pia2021.md. Every quotation is in concepts.json with its citation and is verified against the gazetted text by quote_check.py (the PDFs hash to the sha256 FINDINGS records). Licensed texts are never quoted. No legal threshold is invented: every rule figure typed in the digest prose is a text figure with its citation (gate_typed_literals.py ALLOWED); a value the texts leave open is a stated input with no default.

openReadings.price royalty base year: The Act (PIA Seventh Schedule para 11(1)) starts the benchmarks in 2020, the Regulations' Schedule in 2021. The engine default is the Regulations; graded figures state it; the course teaches both and grades neither. Every graded field is bit-identical under act_2020 (pia_capstone.mjs, discriminate.mjs).
openReadings.new-acreage lease HCT rate: PIA s.267 / NTA s.72 do not say whether a PML granted out of new acreage onshore or in shallow water pays 15 or 30. The Professional capstone states 30 as a reading; no field depends on it (proved under 15).
openReadings.deep offshore HCT under the NTA: NTA s.65(1) against s.72. The Expert capstone states conservative_zero; no field depends on it (proved under aggressive_pml_30 and custom 20).

scopeSeams.ledger arithmetic: OWNED BY the cash flow course (cashflow): discounting, NPV, IRR, payback, the ledger row order, loss-pool arithmetic, working-interest scaling. This course names the provision behind a line and refers there.
scopeSeams.fiscal regime design: OWNED BY the fiscal course (fiscal): the four instruments in the abstract, sliding scales, R-factors, templates, progressivity. The take wording is fiscalConventions.js, shared.

namingCollisions.royalty: the engine's total royalty (production royalty on liquids and gas plus the royalty by price); name the part when only one is meant. Vocabulary section.
namingCollisions.royalty by price: the Seventh Schedule para 11 royalty, always with its base year. Vocabulary section.
namingCollisions.a year under the Act alone: a pia_only year of assessment. Vocabulary section.
namingCollisions.open reading: one of the three questions the texts leave open; never graded. Vocabulary section.
namingCollisions.government take: the engine's undiscounted take (fiscalConventions.js wording); never a tax rate. Vocabulary section.
